title: Arrow-indexed product transition existence
statement: Let J be a small category, F : J → Cat a functor, T_j topologies with every F(a) continuous, and A_j abelian sheaves. Put R_a = F(a)_* and B_j = ∏_{t:j→l} R_t A_l. There exists a family of maps q_a : B_j → R_a B_k such that for every a:j→k and t:k→l, q_a followed by R_a(π_t) equals π_(a≫t) followed by the inverse canonical comparison map induced by F.map_comp a t.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EXZ proof, canonical transition components, adjoint form

proof.text: Use preservation of the indicated product by continuous sheaf pushforward and the product universal property to construct q_a with the displayed projection equations.

theorem exists_arrow_product_transitions
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J]
    (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u}) (T : ∀ j : J, GrothendieckTopology (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (T j) (T k)]
    (A : ∀ j : J, Sheaf (T j) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    let R := fun {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k) ↦
      (F.map a).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (T j) (T k)
    let B := fun j ↦ ∏ᶜ fun t : Σ k : J, j ⟶ k ↦ (R t.2).obj (A t.1)
    ∃ (q : ∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k), B j ⟶ (R a).obj (B k)),
      ∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k) (t : Σ l : J, k ⟶ l),
        q a ≫ (R a).map (Pi.π _ t) =
          Pi.π _ ⟨t.1, a ≫ t.2⟩ ≫
            (Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuousComp'
              (eqToIso (congrArg Cat.Hom.toFunctor (F.map_comp a t.2).symm))
              AddCommGrpCat.{u} (T j) (T k) (T t.1)).inv.app (A t.1)
